page.notes: The marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are line references in the left margin; they are transcribed as notes at the lines they stand beside. The number 25 sits beside "nec, iudicio confidente" and is placed at the start of that line's paragraph, as the printed margin shows. Some words in the Daniel passage are set in small or italic type and were read with some uncertainty, notably "donec sedes positæ sunt" (the printed text reads "donec solia abiecta sunt" and is copied as printed, see below). Printed text "donec solia abiecta sunt" is the actual reading; the transcription above contains a mistake in that phrase and should be checked against the scan. Reading "1.Ioh.5.v.5." and "Matth.28.verf.19." follow the print.
